groups.name: AI Routing, Budget, and Context
groups.intent: Avoid selecting every AI runtime planning skill unless the task spans routing, token cost, protocol shape, and context compression.

groups.name: RAG Retrieval Boundaries
groups.intent: Separate end-to-end RAG workflow selection from storage, pipeline, and namespace boundary checks.

groups.name: Source, Fact, and Evidence
groups.intent: Start with source verification, then add lineage, citation maps, or contradiction review only when the output needs those extra guarantees.

groups.name: Table and Numeric Evidence
groups.intent: Use calculation verification as the default numeric guardrail and add analysis or office reconciliation only for richer document workflows.

groups.name: UI Quality Review
groups.intent: Use the general UI review skill first, then add visual quality, system consistency, accessibility, responsive viewport, Tailwind/Radix system, motion, or premium landing checks for targeted UI risks.

groups.name: Browser Execution Verification
groups.intent: Prefer Playwright automation for reproducible browser verification and add browser check or web-task guidance for narrower execution reviews.

groups.name: Public Claims Compliance
groups.intent: Use claims compliance filtering before publication and add legal, terms, or freshness checks when the claim has policy or time sensitivity.
